description: Review rubric for short-trick / mathematical-shortcut cards.

criteria.label: Mathematical validity
criteria.description: Trick produces the correct answer under stated conditions. SymPy / hand-verification passes.

criteria.label: Applicability clarity
criteria.description: Conditions for when the trick applies AND when it fails are stated explicitly. Critical to prevent misuse.

criteria.label: Memorability
criteria.description: Trick is short enough to remember under exam pressure. If it requires more steps than first-principles, it's not a trick.

criteria.label: Worked example quality
criteria.description: At least one PYQ-style worked example showing the trick saves time vs first-principles.

criteria.label: Boundary safety
criteria.description: 'When this trick fails' annotation is present and concrete. Not just 'sometimes it doesn't apply'.

approval_rule: mathematical_validity MUST be 5/5 (no near-misses on math). Other criteria meet minimum_pass.
